download: explicit user-authorized download_datasets CLI; default /mnt/nvme02/data/vhuman, assets never bundled in Git

sources.name: SpeakingFaces
sources.purpose: speech/expression sequence; manually annotate landmarks and occlusion; not calibrated 3D ground truth
sources.license: CC-BY-4.0, verified on official dataset download page
sources.evaluation: subject-disjoint; independent annotated frames; do not fit on evaluated frames
sources.calibration: RGB/thermal alignment does not establish synchronized calibrated multi-view 3D truth

sources.name: Multiface
sources.license: CC-BY-NC-4.0; research evaluation only, excluded from permissive runtime/training distribution
sources.purpose: calibrated held-out camera views, tracked geometry and expression sequences
sources.evaluation: disjoint capture frames/cameras; transform KRT/head pose/mesh into H metres before evaluation; native tracked topology needs explicit correspondence
sources.starter_size: 16.2 GB mini dataset per official README
sources.calibration: camera KRT, tracked meshes/head poses, textures and audio

sources.name: NeRSemble v2 and benchmark
sources.access: approval request required; received download URL stays private
sources.license: dataset access terms; exact media license not verified from publicly readable documentation, do not infer from toolkit code
sources.calibration: 16 synchronized calibrated cameras, color correction; benchmark pointclouds and optional FLAME tracking
sources.starter_size: SVFR 125 MB / 391 portraits; monocular avatar 144 MB; NVS 3.34 GB without all pointclouds, per official benchmark README
sources.purpose: posed/neutral portrait geometry, held-out views and dynamic expression quality
sources.evaluation: hidden benchmark targets unavailable locally; use independent public validation split for tuning, official submission for final scoring; FLAME model license is separate

sources.name: Digital Emily 2
sources.access: direct manual links for OBJ, maps, camera calibration and EXR references
sources.license: research/illustration only, noncommercial and no redistribution notice on official page; not permissive
sources.calibration: reference cameras plus unpolarized, cross/parallel-polarized and specular-only point-light images
sources.purpose: single-subject skin/normal/displacement, diffuse/specular separation and renderer material validation
sources.evaluation: verify exposure, light power/direction and map conventions from archives before treating as calibrated BRDF fitting truth; preserve source mesh for independent comparison

sources.name: NoW
sources.license: custom noncommercial scientific/educational/artistic use; no redistribution
sources.calibration: 2054 real portraits, 100 subjects; independent neutral scans, 20 validation subjects with public ground truth after access
sources.purpose: neutral identity under profile pose, expressions and occlusions
sources.evaluation: use official scan-distance alignment protocol; scan topology differs from GNM/ICT; not a calibrated photograph-camera or BRDF dataset

sources.name: FaceScape
sources.access: license agreement and email request required; current download site relocated January 2026
sources.license: custom noncommercial research with restrictions on publishing portraits/rendered models
sources.calibration: multi-view imagery, camera parameters and corresponding meshes; uniform-topology models and 4K displacement/texture maps
sources.purpose: high-resolution geometry, multi-expression likeness and cross-view consistency
sources.evaluation: keep held-out subjects, expressions and views; use surface-distance evaluation across topology or explicit correspondence

sources.name: FaceOLAT
sources.access: registration/login and research terms required; full dataset about 9 TB
sources.license: academic research only per processing repository; exact terms at access site
sources.calibration: multi-view 4K one-light-at-a-time captures; availability/completeness of camera/light metadata must be checked per release
sources.purpose: future high-frequency portrait relighting and diffuse/specular fitting evaluation
sources.evaluation: request a small processed subject subset; preprocessing is substantial and tracking pipeline is marked TODO in current processing README
